collection.title: BMW X3 2010 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit an BMW X3 2010 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this X3 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
